steps.title: See how your pages perform, without leaving the page
items: 1 · A visitor accepts cookies and shops
2 · The site's blocks send GA4 events through GTM
3 · The author sees the page's numbers in Experience Workspace

steps.caption: A new visitor: the cookie bar sits at the bottom. **Accept all** turns on analytics
Google loads only now, after the page has rendered: the site keeps its 100 Lighthouse score
Seeing the product list and picking a product are GA4 events. Nobody tagged this page
**Add to cart**: the block sends the product, price and quantity
The author opens the same page in Experience Workspace

steps.name: Page Insights - G4A
steps.caption: **Panels** › **Page Insights**: this page's numbers, next to the page
Views, visitors and time on page for the last 30 days, against the 30 days before
From product views to add to carts, checkouts and purchases
And where they came from: search, newsletter, social, campaigns

steps.kicker: GA4 and GTM on Edge Delivery
steps.title: Marketers get their data. Pages stay fast. Authors see results
items: Consent first: Google loads only after Accept, after the page renders
Blocks send the events: new pages are tracked when they're published
Results next to the page in Experience Workspace, no GA4 login needed
